A 9 July 2026 first-person forum contributor says they visited two weekends previously and found informal cruising still possible near the lake; this is a recent retrospective claim, not independent official endorsement. April 2024 users reported vegetation removal reducing seclusion and a 2021 user warned of broken glass. Swimming/FKK and public sex rules require separate official checks.

records.description_rewritten: Kiesgrube Leuben near Salzburger Straße comprises two former quarry lakes and a wooded rise. A 11 May 2026 visitor says the hill area is heavily overgrown with brambles and effectively inactive; another post that day merely praises the scenery. The last September 2025 user similarly describes the hill as dead and suggests Neuer Anbau/Moritzburg as an alternative. This is recent negative evidence, not evidence that no encounters ever happen; the two lakes and raised area are distinct subareas.

recent_dated_signals.note: Visitor describes inaccessible overgrown hill and no cruising.
Separate commenter says the lake is nice, not proof of sex.

records.description_rewritten: Stausee Oberwartha refers to a small pond/reservoir and adjoining woods by an upper basin west of Dresden near the motorway. The source archive's latest 11 June 2025 comment is a question, and April 27 2025 prior user says past activity still occasionally occurred at a rear retention basin. All predate the November 2025 cutoff. Older visitors mention protected/operational grounds and warning signs. Current reservoir and public access rules, swimming permission and cruising remain unverified.
